finding: The incidence of post-cesarean section SSI was 8.5%, and risk factors included emergency cesarean section, prolonged rupture of membranes, prolonged labor, excessive blood loss, longer surgery duration, and low postoperative PCV.
mod_finding: This study examined risk factors for surgical site infection (SSI) following cesarean section, but did not specifically analyze mode of delivery as a risk factor.
